seasonalTasks.title: Winter pruning (dormant)
seasonalTasks.body: Remove 1/6 oldest canes; thin twiggy growth. Aim for 6–8 productive canes per mature bush.

seasonalTasks.title: Mummy berry primary infection cover
seasonalTasks.body: FRAC 3 (myclobutanil) or FRAC 11 — alternate per stewardship. Begin at green-tip stage.

seasonalTasks.title: Anthracnose pre-bloom
seasonalTasks.body: Captan or chlorothalonil. Critical for fruit-rot prevention.

seasonalTasks.title: Spotted-wing drosophila trap monitoring
seasonalTasks.body: Apple cider vinegar + yeast traps; 7-d insecticide intervals once SWD detected.

seasonalTasks.title: Harvest window
seasonalTasks.body: Pick every 5–7 d; berries fully blue + drop into hand without pull.

notes: Mid-season highbush; needs cross-pollinator (Patriot, Duke, Jersey). Soil pH 4.5–5.0 mandatory — sulfur-down at planting.
